title: Mumbai
summary: Mumbai, formerly Bombay, is the capital of Maharashtra and India's financial capital, on the Konkan coast. Built on an archipelago of seven islands, it passed from Portuguese rule in 1535 to the British in 1661 and was leased to the East India Company in 1668. It grew into a major port and trading centre and was officially renamed Mumbai in 1995.
